LESSON: COMMUNICATING TO

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.4: Communicating to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Communicating to. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you pray?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate postures for prayer as way of communicating with God
2. recite simple prayers for his/her spiritual growth
3. desire to thank and praise God through prayers.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate postures for prayer as way of communicating with God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate postures for prayer as way of communicating with God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recite simple prayers for his/her spiritual growth
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite simple prayers for his/her spiritual growth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. desire to thank and praise God through prayers.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to thank and praise God through prayers. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Communicating to.
2. Explain Communicating to to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Communicating to.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate postures for prayer as way of communicating with God
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Communicating to. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How do you pray?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate postures for prayer as way of communicating with God
2. recite simple prayers for his/her spiritual growth
3. desire to thank and praise God through prayers.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
